primitives.name: Dispatcher
primitives.summary: Reads a shell command once and spawns each guard only where the command could trip it.

primitives.name: Guard library
primitives.summary: The shell library every guard sources: payload reader, scanners, quote mask, launcher table, git readers, refusal.

primitives.name: Dangerous commands guard
primitives.summary: Refuses what the reflog cannot bring back, bare force and protected-branch pushes, remote deletes, rm aimed at a root.

primitives.name: Env access guard
primitives.summary: Judges an env file read by guardrails.envFiles: the deny list, the allow list, then the policy, git by default.

primitives.name: Credential leak guard
primitives.summary: Refuses reads of credential stores outside dotenv, credential-ish env dumps, and a curl or wget carrying one.

primitives.name: Package manager guard
primitives.summary: Refuses npm, npx, yarn and bun where the resolved packageManagers.node is pnpm; silent in every other repository.

primitives.name: Store writes guard
primitives.summary: Refuses every write to App Store Connect: an asc verb that is not a read, a store script without --confirm.

primitives.name: Commit hygiene guard
primitives.summary: Holds a subject to commit.pattern or the convention, requires commit.trailer, refuses git add -A and git add .

primitives.name: Large file guard
primitives.summary: Flags a file over 256 KiB once a Write lands it; advisory, CLAUDE_MAX_WRITE_BYTES is its one switch.

primitives.name: rtk rewrite
primitives.summary: Wires rtk hook claude from the plugin; silent without rtk, and git in a linked worktree goes through unrewritten.

primitives.name: Guardrails session hook
primitives.summary: Tells the first turn what no file says: a missing jq, an invalid config layer, a linked worktree still to set up.

primitives.name: Sync hook
primitives.summary: Runs the Sync at startup and prints its lines; a repository without .ai/references.json gets no output.

primitives.name: Commit-msg hook
primitives.summary: The subject check as a git commit-msg hook, so a commit typed in a terminal meets it; wired from .vite-hooks/commit-msg.

primitives.name: Agentic config
primitives.summary: How a repository works for an agent: a committed file, a local layer over it, both against the schema.

primitives.name: Config resolver
primitives.summary: Reads, validates and merges the layers, in TypeScript for the scripts and in jq for the guards, one behaviour.

primitives.name: guardrails key
primitives.summary: forcePush, commitOnProtected, protectedBranches and envFiles; a local layer may only tighten them.

primitives.name: commit key
primitives.summary: The convention or pattern a commit subject follows and the trailer every commit carries.

primitives.name: packageManagers key
primitives.summary: The Node package manager a repository works with, inferred from the lockfile when nothing sets it.

primitives.name: gate key
primitives.summary: The Gate's command, its Steps in order and the Checks after them; the command inferred from the check script.

primitives.name: pr key
primitives.summary: pr.merge: auto, the Ship script merges a ready pull request; ask, the dev does. A local layer may only tighten it.

primitives.name: worktree key
primitives.summary: The commands a fresh worktree still needs; the session hook names them in a linked worktree.

primitives.name: references file
primitives.summary: The References a repository reads, in .ai/references.json: dir, repository, ref, kept and skipped paths, what and when.

primitives.name: Setup
primitives.summary: Pins dw-sdlc and adds the gate key on a yes; writes the machine's local config, excludes, deny rules, lease exception.

primitives.name: Doctor
primitives.summary: One PASS, WARN, FAIL or INFO line per machine check, a drift of plugin and package among them; exits 1 on a FAIL.

primitives.name: Sync
primitives.summary: Brings every declared Reference to its ref, shallow and sparse; a clone with local edits is reported and left alone.

primitives.name: References setup
primitives.summary: Makes a repository ready for References: the Router with its table from the file, the excludes, the ignore rules.

primitives.name: dw-sdlc primitives
primitives.summary: Names the Primitives that own each path it is given, with their summaries and documents; plain or --json.

primitives.name: Ship script
primitives.summary: dw-sdlc pr ship answers the Action a pull request needs next, by exit code; pr reviewed pins a clean review to its head.

primitives.name: sdlc-setup
primitives.summary: The user-invoked skill that runs the setup as a dry run, asks before it pins dw-sdlc, then runs it and the doctor.

primitives.name: sdlc-doctor
primitives.summary: The user-invoked skill that runs the doctor from the repository and shows its lines; it fixes nothing unasked.

primitives.name: sdlc-references-add
primitives.summary: The user-invoked skill that runs the setup, writes one Reference's entry into .ai/references.json and syncs its dir.

primitives.name: sdlc-pr-ship
primitives.summary: The user-invoked skill that calls the Ship script, does the agent's Action, calls again and stops on the dev's turn.

primitives.name: Marketplace
primitives.summary: The catalogue Claude Code installs the plugin from, this repository's own; it lists sdlc alone.

primitives.name: sdlc plugin
primitives.summary: The manifest wiring each guard and hook to its event, and the README; its version and the marketplace's bump together.

primitives.name: dw-sdlc package
primitives.summary: The workspace package the plugin links to, an install copying the link; npm ships it as JavaScript tsc emits.

primitives.name: Release workflow
primitives.summary: Turns pending changesets into the version pull request; once it merges, publishes the package to npm.

primitives.name: dw-sdlc bin
primitives.summary: The package's command line: one table of subcommands, each a module under src/commands/.

primitives.name: pnpm check
primitives.summary: The Gate command: dw-sdlc gate behind the check script, the same in a terminal and in CI.

primitives.name: dw-sdlc gate
primitives.summary: Runs gate.steps to the first failure, then every Check; one line per failure, --json, exit 0, 1 or 2.

primitives.name: dw-sdlc check
primitives.summary: Runs one Check of the Gate by name and no Step, on its defaults where the config leaves it off.

primitives.name: Check registry
primitives.summary: What a Check the package ships is, the list the Gate runs them in, and the markdown and file reading they share.

primitives.name: primitives Check
primitives.summary: Holds the catalogue to the tree: unique ids, known groups, short summaries, real paths, each root's files named.

primitives.name: agents-map Check
primitives.summary: Holds AGENTS.md to its budget, the Gate command, a row to the catalogue, Task Router paths that exist, skills in step.

primitives.name: markdown-budget Check
primitives.summary: Holds each file a glob matches to that glob's line and byte budget; by default the agent docs under docs/agents.

primitives.name: markdown-refs Check
primitives.summary: Fails a relative link or image in markdown whose path or heading anchor does not resolve in the files git sees.

primitives.name: temporal-language Check
primitives.summary: Fails a changelog phrase from kody's list in a durable doc; decision records, research notes, changelogs exempt.

primitives.name: decision-records Check
primitives.summary: Holds the decision records to numbers without a gap, a title each and a status from the allowed set.

primitives.name: file-size-ratchet Check
primitives.summary: Holds each file to its group's line limit, or to its count in a committed baseline that --update-baseline only tightens.

primitives.name: comment-budget Check
primitives.summary: Holds each JavaScript, TypeScript and shell comment block under the roots to a few lines of prose, three by default.

primitives.name: Pre-commit hook
primitives.summary: vp staged over the staged files, vp lint --fix and vp fmt, before the commit-msg hook judges the subject.

primitives.name: Dependabot
primitives.summary: Grouped npm and GitHub Actions updates once a week, each 7 days after its release.
